conventions.frames: aerie half (half 0): blocks from the player's feet where they struck, +Z toward the gong (the frame turns with their yaw), +X on their left; summit half (half 1): the summit layout, from the slot centre's corner at SURFACE_Y, unturned
conventions.camera: eye in the frame; yaw/pitch as Minecraft (yaw 0 looks +Z, 90 looks -X; +pitch looks down) and relative to the frame; roll in degrees, positive lowers the view's right side (in game: rotation.rotateZ(-roll))
conventions.actors: [x, y, z, w, qx, qy, qz]: the model origin, and the rotation that turns a model facing +Z (after GeckoLib's mirror and half turn); the Roc is drawn at 1.25 scale; consecutive quaternions keep a positive dot product
conventions.pov: while 1, the player model hides head, body, right_arm, left_arm
conventions.hold: the scene may wait on the hold tick, inside the cloud, until the summit is ready; ticks after it run late by the wait
